artifact_observations.location: Bass guitar neck and headstock area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The geometry of the bass guitar is inconsistent. The neck seems to merge into the hand without clear definition of frets or strings. The headstock area is blurry and lacks logical mechanical structure (tuning pegs are missing or malformed).

The microphone stand exhibits unnatural softness and slight warping, particularly where it intersects with the dark background, suggesting poor edge definition rather than optical depth-of-field blur.
